label: Formulated and introduced The General Will & The Social Contract
description: Jean-Jacques Rousseau formulated and introduced the concept of "The General Will & The Social Contract", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Enlightenment & Social Contract as part of Jean-Jacques Rousseau's canonical writings.

label: Smith critiqued Rousseau's Discourse on Inequality, defending commercial interdependence and mutual sympathy against pastoral nostalgia
description: Adam Smith engaged in a direct critique of Jean-Jacques Rousseau's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Jean-Jacques Rousseau's perspective to Adam Smith's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Enlightenment & Social Contract era.
